reviewers.summary: The pinning path can reject ordinary evidence containing the format name, and it can alter source payload field names in the stored snapshots.

findingList.message: Detect the pin format by parsing the JSON and checking its root format property. A substring in ordinary evidence currently makes the store reject that basis.

evidence.codePathTraced: Every new basis passes through ValidateSourceBasisContent, which checks for the format name anywhere in the content before parsing it as JSON.
evidence.failureScenario: An ordinary uploaded evidence document contains the text "source-record-pins-v1". The content is not JSON, so committing that evidence throws BasisIntegrityException and rejects the upload.

findingList.message: The serializer can rewrite payload dictionary keys while creating a supposedly exact source snapshot. Preserve dictionary keys verbatim when serializing pins.

evidence.codePathTraced: SerializeRecord serializes the payload fields dictionary using SourceRecordJsonOptions created with JsonSerializerDefaults.Web.
evidence.failureScenario: A source record contains a field key such as "EngineID". Web JSON defaults camel-case dictionary keys, so the pinned content contains a different key and no longer reproduces the source snapshot.

reviewers.summary: The three new tests exercise the named acceptance criteria, including deterministic pins, changed and unchanged reassessments, and a stale revision conflict. The workflow runs `dotnet test AirlineDemo.sln`, which includes the named .NET tests and the existing `SourceReadEndpointTests`.
The source-pin validation can reject otherwise ordinary evidence when its text contains the format marker. I found no other security vulnerability in the changed code.

findingList.message: The substring check misclassifies ordinary evidence text as source-pin JSON. Detect the format from a parsed JSON object and exact `format` property so document content cannot trigger a parsing failure. OWASP A10:2025 (Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions).

evidence.codePathTraced: Every basis content string is checked for the source format marker before being parsed as JSON.
evidence.failureScenario: A presenter uploads a document whose extracted text contains `source-record-pins-v1` as ordinary prose. The text is not JSON, so the store rejects the basis and the evidence submission fails.
